items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And then there's a guy in Iowa they call Tony.

ctx.x: And then there's a guy in Iowa they call Tony. He got a pattern on that thing, they put two of them kazookes together. Kazooke. Made some mutes out of it. Made some mutes out of it. Called them bomber mutes. But that one kazooke would give a whole different effect, man. It wasn't one, but Joe could hold that thing that one kazooke and get the dog on his effect.

I mean he used the kazoo as a mute? Yeah, just hold it, hold his hand. You see, Joe used everything. He used to use a glass. Glass? What do you think? You'd say a tin can? Tin can. They'd have derbies, you know, they'd put that derby and do that.
